extension.name: System - FEC Template Switch
extension.author: FreeExtraChips
extension.description: Forces selected components (default: com_easyblog) to render with a legacy template (default: rt_lumiere). Gantry-safe: switches via template style id so style params are loaded. Disable or uninstall once the blog is ported to the new design.

field.name: components
field.label: Components (comma separated)
field.description: Component option values to force onto the legacy template, e.g. com_easyblog,com_search

field.name: style_id
field.label: Template style ID (0 = auto)
field.description: Style id from #__template_styles. Leave 0 to auto-detect the template's default style (recommended).
